subject: Q4 numbers for Scranton
body: Michael, I need the Scranton branch Q4 numbers by Monday: sales to date, margin, and your forecast against Stamford. Stamford is a little ahead right now, so I'd like to hear the plan. Thanks, David.

subject: Bulk pricing discrepancy on our test order
body: Hi Michael, we placed a 60-case test order through Dunder Mifflin Infinity and were charged full price, not the 10% bulk rate Jim quoted us. We like working with your branch, but we can't sign the district contract until the online pricing matches the quote. Best, Maria Delgado, Procurement.

subject: REMINDER: annual harassment training sign-off
body: Hi Michael, just a reminder that your annual harassment training sign-off is now three weeks overdue. It takes about 20 minutes. Thanks, Toby.

subject: Serenity by Jan: candle order
body: Michael, the Scranton branch still owes me for the 40 candles you ordered for the office. Please pay the invoice. Jan.

subject: Infinity bug (FYI)
body: Hey, heads up: there's a pricing bug on Infinity where the bulk discount isn't applying on big orders. It's on the board as DM-101. Not my fault, the codebase was like that when I got it. Ryan.

subject: Security breach (vending machine)
body: Michael, someone has been taking more than one bag of chips per purchase from the vending machine. I have begun an investigation. Do not tell Jim. Dwight.
